notes.title: Minor bugfix in Mining Drill
notes.notes:
The good news is that we are sure we fixed the big bug that made the game crash randomly.
The bad news is that in the process we damaged the Mining Drill.
We've been out of office for a few weeks and dealing with some seasonal flu and stuff, but finally we got hands back on deck and fixed the bug, so now the Mining Drill works fine again :D

notes.title: Important Bugfix
notes.notes:
There's a big bug that's been on our minds since the release day.
The game crashes on certain computers, the crash happens randomly, is not easy to replicate, and it's not consistent on any particular level or section of the game.
We've been tormented by this bug for a while now, but we found out there's a memory problem in one building.
We fixed that and hopefully, the infamous [b]crash bug[/b] will be no more. 

Still, if the game crashes on you, please let us know. 

Sincerely, The Ceiba Team.

notes.title: Bugfixes and an important announcement
notes.notes:
Hi!

So, there's this annoying bug that's extremely difficult to replicate where, if you have two displays with different resolutions, the minigame with the circuits might not work correctly.
It took us almost a year to finally replicate this bug, but we made it and fixed it!!!

A few players also found a couple of localization errors, we also addressed those.

Besides that, we have an announcement to make, we will probably make a public statement with more details, but for now, you'll notice that the splash screen is different. That's because BadLand Publishing and Ceiba Software & Arts decided to terminate the publishing contract. This was a mutual decision; we are still in a good relationship, but the important part is that SOOT will appear as self-published for the time being. 

Right now if you want to help us, you can do so by leaving a review and sharing the game on your social networks, every bit of help is super helpful for us, we really appreciate it all.

notes.title: Important Bugfix!
notes.notes:
We got reports of a bug in the save system that would cause all the progress in the current objectives to reset when a level is loaded.
Not all levels present this error, but in the ones that do (like Tarqeq), the bug can be really annoying.

Thanks to everyone who reported it!
We keep working to ensure SOOT is in the best state possible!

- The Ceiba Team
